chapter_0: Board the Hexahedron and press the big red button!
&oPressing the Big Red Button
Press the Big Red Button
Getting Started
In this strange new dimension you can find Old Vector Operators.
Placing them onto the three plugs inside the Hexahedron will allow you to travel to new dimensions.
Each of the Old Vector Operators
adds +1. So for example, two in a row will send you to dimension 2.
&oSee Where it Takes you
While holding the default &otilde&r key (~) you can mine a lot of adjacent blocks at once as long as they are of the same type.
This is quite a handy tool that prevents tasks from becoming to grindy.
You can rebind this key in the controls menu under "FTB Ultimine".
&oYes there is Veinminer
I will Break all the Things!
Excavate all the Things
Using the FTB map you can force load chunks so that setups work even when you are not currently present in that specific area.
Simply click the second map icon in the top left of your inventory screen. There you will be able to claim chunks.
You can shift right-click on loaded chunks on the map to force load them.
&oLoading what you are not Observing
The Chunks will be Loaded
Loading Chunks
The Akashic Tome contains all the guidebooks you will ever need.
If you are ever unsure on how to do something, make sure to check the guidebook of the corresponding mod.
Once you have morphed The Tome into one of the guidebooks you can Left-click it to transform it back into the Akashic Tome.
&oKnowlege is Power
Hand over the Library
The Akashic Tome
Because of the nature of this modpack, it is best to not push your render distance beyond 12 chunks.
This goes mainly for when the Hexahedron is changing its location to a fully new dimension.
Understood
Load Chunks with care
If the Hexahedron breaks down in some unintended way, you can resolve a lot of problems by executing the following command:
/function hexahedron:hexahedron_rebuild
This will reconstruct the technical bits inside the Hexahedron.
Your base will remain fully intact.
Understood
In Case of Emergency
Chapter 0
chapter_1: Digging up the huge columns of cobblestone can provide you with the stone to make some basic tools and a furnace.
Remember that there is Veinminer in this pack, which allows you to collect a lot of cobble quickly.
Using your generated power you can now charge up Empty Vector Operators to create Charged Vector Operators.
Cut Copper can be smelted into Copper Ingots.
You will need to scrape the oxidation off first before smelting it.
The Peat Fired Engine will allow you to generate your first bit of power.
Simply provide it with peat and a redstone signal.
Do note that this generator can only burn peat and nothing else.
Peat is a powerful natural fuel source that allows you to conserve wood since you can now burn this stuff instead.
Droopfruit in its raw state isn't the greatest food source. But it can keep you alive.
Consider making Droop Soup in order to improve its nutritional value.
New berries can only appear when the plant grows downwards.

chapter_4: The Flamethrower is a powerful weapon that deals direct AOE burning damage to your targets.
The shrine in the brimwood planes will erupt and spew out a Blaze if a ignited TNT is dropped into the central hole.
The Magma Crucible will be able to smelt any Glowstone into Energized Glowstone.
The Gourmaryllis can eat anything eatable to generate mana.
The Kekimurus will convert any cakes placed next to it into mana.
Both these flowers can be found in dimension 24.
Runes can be made from Mystical Petals in combination with mana.
You will just need to find flowers in the right colours.
Glowstone can be created in the Spirit Crucible and melted in the Magma Crucible for liquid Energised Glowstone.
Energised Glowstone is a major component in the creation of Blaze Fuel.
Molten Steel can be made in a Basin using a Basin Lid. After that it can be poured into the right mold.
Crushing Wheels are not only able to Crush Blaze burners into Blaze Dust. But they are also extremely efficient at crushing down rocks quickly.
A set of Crushing Wheels at full speed can go through stacks of stone in a matter of seconds.
This should allow you to crush the different stone types from the different dimensions extremely quickly.
You can find the occasional Runewood Tree in this dimension. Make sure you keep some alive to harvest their sap.
Runic trees can be tapped for runic sap by right-clicking with a bottle on the stripped log where the sap is coming out of the tree.
Blood combined with any Quartz Dust in the Crystallizer
Mechanical Crafting is needed in order to make the Crushing Wheels.
Pepermint powder and Frostmint will be needed to construct the Blast Chiller and catalyse reactions within the machine.
The Spirit Altar can be used to create many items of magical nature.
When crafting, it uses item components from the pedestals.
Spirits are also needed for the crafting process. The Spirits can be put directly on the Spirit Altar itself.
The Altar can hold more Spirits than it needs. The leftover spirits will stay on the Altar for your next craft.
Using the Spirit Crucible you can generate a whole assortment of resources using different &oimpetuses&r.
You can create spirits by crushing runes on a cutting board or by pulverizing them.
All four Gummy Rings can be found in dimension 24. In a Cooking Pot they can be turned into the highly flamable Lumisene.
Gummy Rings can be duplicated by spouting them with a small amount of Lumisene.
This should allow you to create infinite Lumisene with the right setup.
With the Metallurgic Infuser you will be able to make Control Circuits.
Chocolate Chips can be made by chilling molten chocolate with the right press.
Chocolate does not have to be created from scratch. Existing chocolate items can be melted down in a heated basin.
Coke Bricks can be made from Limestone, Cinder Flour and Ash.
Ash can be obtained by shovelling it up after anything that can burn has fully burned down.
By placing Bulk Fermenters in a column and heating them from below, you can make Blaze Fuel.
Items must be pushed into the structure by hoppers.
Blaze Burners can be crushed using Crushing Wheels to yield Blaze Powder and Blaze Rods.
With Blaze Burners it is possible to extract the iron from the endless blood ocean located in dimension 16.
Where this blood came from does not seem to concern you...
A stone generator in this dimension will generate Brimstone.
Crushing it will yeild Netherrack, Sulfur and a tiny amount of Cobalt.
You can extract endless sap from a tree by placing an Extruder on a log and placing lava and a block of Alchemical Calx next to the machine.
Using the Centrifuge you can turn Metal Swarf into lead.

chapter_6: Welcome to dimension &k999&r: &lThe Edge of Reality
In a abandonned Hexahedron there sits a Broken Vector Operator...
The Broken Vector Operator can be repaired, but this process needs to be executed fast and properly planned beforehand.
There are twelve total recipe steps that need to happen in order.
The twelfth and final step is to place the Broken Vector Operator back on the Vector Tuner &lwithin 10 minutes&r.
At any point you can place the unfinished Vector back on the Vector Tuner to reset the time and start over at step one.
This will not be easy, but you made it this far. Plan ahead and you will be more than capable of doing this.
You got this, best of luck!
If you would somehow lose the Broken Vector in any way, you can use the following command while standing next to the Vector Tuner to reset the Broken Vector:
The true nature of the Edge of Reality is undocumented.
You will only know what there is to do here once you visit this destination...
